comment: Worked out by hand: a rod of r 10 and 30 long (100 pi 30 = 9424.7780); a 4 x 5 rectangle wrapped onto its side and raised 1 (20 (11^2 - 10^2) / 20 = 21), a 4 x 3 one sunk 1 (12 (10^2 - 9^2) / 20 = 11.4), and a 4 x 4 square raised 2 from the top (32). The raised rectangle reaches y = 11, the square z = 32.
